scope: Final four captures,2 reviewers,48 responses each

policy.uncertainty: Unmapped, unknown and unclear answers are wrong. Multiple activity possibilities containing or are not resolved in favor of the key. Sitting is not knapping; holding a tool is not chopping; standing while holding is not carry-state recognition.
policy.carrying: All actually held items count, including axe, logs, basket and elder stick. Elder stick is shown by composer despite held=none.
policy.sex: NOT_RENDERED_SINGLE_ADULT_BODY earns0/8 sex recognition, never waived from24 denominator.
policy.held: Recognizable axe-like/log-like/basket-like categories count. Generic shape and ambiguous alternate tool or container descriptions do not. Berry contents need not be named for basket.
policy.independence: The two supplied fresh image-only reviews are graded by a separate key-aware grader; original responses unchanged.
